sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: two-year planning and revised pricing
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

We value our long partnership and want a viable two-year agreement that gives your team planning certainty.

The price history in po:4500001201 and po:4500001288 is our starting point for assessing the increase.
The should-cost assessment cost:part:PH-100 supports a more moderate adjustment than the proposed increase.
Please reconcile the notice in doc:D01-LETTER with the requirement in ctr:D01-FRAMEWORK before bringing the increase into effect.

We propose these alternatives, all for a 24-month contract, with 4,000 housings annually and unchanged FCA / 35-day lead time:
A: EUR 49.58 per unit, payment 60 days net, effective 2027-04-01.
B: EUR 49.19 per unit, payment 30 days net, effective 2027-04-01.
C: EUR 49.14 per unit, payment 30 days net, effective 2027-02-01.

The 30-day options provide earlier cash in exchange for price, while the two-year commitment supports capacity planning. Which package best fits your operation? Please also share your full per-unit cost breakdown, including energy, labour, material and overhead, and explain the remaining drivers beyond the wage increase you identified.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our offer stands at a price of €50.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We highly value our long-standing relationship and are pleased to support your capacity planning with a 24-month agreement starting 1 February 2027, which respects the contractual notice period. In return for this extended commitment and maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms, we are prepared to revise our offer to €50.40 per unit. Alternatively, we offer a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027.

Please understand that as a privately owned family business we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns, but we assure you this price accurately reflects our current operational realities. Our main cost drivers are SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: revised 24-month package
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for taking the evidence into account and extending the agreement to 24 months. We understand your preference to keep internal costs confidential; an indication of the changes in scrap and gas costs, without disclosing your detailed accounts, would help us understand the adjustment.

The on-time delivery record in sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3 is also relevant to the balance of price and supply reliability in this agreement.

We can increase our April package to EUR 49.25 per unit, payment 30 days net, contract 24 months, effective 2027-04-01, with 4,000 housings annually and unchanged FCA / 35-day lead time. This retains your preferred payment terms and the longer planning commitment. Please review the price on that basis.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

It is always a pleasure to work with your respected house, given our long shared history. We have reviewed the delivery record you cited; it holds and we took it into account. While we keep our detailed accounts confidential, we can confirm that the recent increases in scrap and gas costs are significant drivers behind this necessary adjustment. 

In recognition of your revised offer and our valued partnership, we are prepared to reduce our price to €50.40 per unit for the 24-month agreement starting April 2027. Our Angebot consists of a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: further revision on the April package
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the further reduction. We recognise that scrap and gas affect your operation, and we are retaining the two-year commitment and your standard payment terms to support predictable production and cash flow.

The on-time delivery record in sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q2 provides additional context for balancing supply performance and the price adjustment.

We can revise our proposal to EUR 49.30 per unit, payment 30 days net, contract 24 months, effective 2027-04-01; annual volume remains 4,000 housings, with FCA and 35-day lead time unchanged. Please review what further price adjustment you can make on this package.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your revised offer and the continued commitment to our long-standing partnership. It is always a pleasure to work together with trusted companions in our industry, and we value the deep roots our companies share. 

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We have already taken that delivery record data into account. As we have already factored our delivery performance into our previous concession, we cannot make further adjustments based on this point. We must therefore maintain our offer of €50.40 per unit for the 24-month agreement starting April 2027. 

To reiterate the full terms of our offer, we quote a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: price or earlier implementation
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Understood: we will not ask you to count the delivery record twice. Let us focus instead on a commercial trade that supports your recovery of costs.

We offer two revised alternatives, both with payment 30 days net and a 24-month contract:
A: EUR 49.35 per unit, effective 2027-04-01.
B: EUR 49.25 per unit, effective 2027-02-01.

Option B brings the adjustment forward in exchange for a lower unit price, as you previously indicated an interest in February implementation. Annual volume remains 4,000 housings and FCA / 35-day lead time remains unchanged. Please review both packages and indicate the price you can support against each implementation date.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We appreciate your constructive proposal and the option to bring the implementation forward to 1 February 2027. In exchange for this earlier effective date, we are pleased to reduce our price to €50.20 per unit. This concession reflects our dedication to our long-standing relationship and provides a viable path forward for both our companies. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

As an alternative package beside our current offer, we can propose a price of €50.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. Alternatively, with valid from 1 February 2027: €50.20 per unit.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: February implementation package
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for confirming that February implementation enables a lower price. We will focus on that structure, retaining the 30-day payment terms and the two-year planning commitment.

We can increase the February proposal to EUR 49.30 per unit, payment 30 days net, contract 24 months, effective 2027-02-01. Annual volume remains 4,000 housings, FCA, with a 35-day lead time.

Please review your price further against this revised package and return your February terms as the main offer rather than an alternative description.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your focus on the February implementation, which we now present as our main offer. However, your minor adjustment does not allow us to make a further concession. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

For our long-standing relationship and the work of our traditional family foundry, we stand by the quality of our craftsmanship. For our offer, we propose a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

We hope these terms allow us to continue our proud partnership and serve your needs with the high standards you have come to expect from our region.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
